Computational neuroscience · NeuroAI · dynamical systems

Yuanfei (Cheyenne) Hu

I study how structured neural dynamics support memory, representation and adaptive behavior. My work combines mechanistic modelling, simulation and machine learning to examine how complex patterns of activity can produce stable computation.

MSc Biomedical Informatics, National University of Singapore

Selected work

Independent research · 2025—present

Memory consolidation and replay in continuous-attractor networks

When does replay separate overlapping memories, and when does it increase interference?

I developed a computational model and matched simulation study of replay on continuous memory representations.

Can geometric consistency reveal faults under changes of coordinate frame?

We tested a lightweight detector built from equivariance, kinematic and command–observation residuals.
